_help.OrganizationName: Shown in the dashboard header, e.g. 'Contoso IT'. Empty = no name.
_help.LogoPath: PNG, JPG, GIF or SVG, under 512 KB. Relative to the psToDo folder or absolute, e.g. 'img\company-logo.png'. It is embedded in the page. Empty = no logo.
_help.StaleAfterHours: The page warns when it is older than this: the scheduled report run has probably stopped.
_help.TimelineDays: How many days ahead the expiry timeline covers.
_help.ExpiredNotifyDays: Must match $expiredNotifyDays in psToDo-Onprem-v1.0.ps1 (reminders after expiry).
